074/**
075 * The base class for axes that display value data, where values are measured
076 * using the {@code double} primitive.  The two key subclasses are
077 * {@link DateAxis} and {@link NumberAxis}.
078 */
079public abstract class ValueAxis extends Axis
080        implements Cloneable, PublicCloneable, Serializable {
081
082    /** For serialization. */
083    private static final long serialVersionUID = 3698345477322391456L;
084
085    /** The default axis range. */
086    public static final Range DEFAULT_RANGE = new Range(0.0, 1.0);
087
088    /** The default auto-range value. */
089    public static final boolean DEFAULT_AUTO_RANGE = true;
090
091    /** The default inverted flag setting. */
092    public static final boolean DEFAULT_INVERTED = false;
093
094    /** The default minimum auto range. */
095    public static final double DEFAULT_AUTO_RANGE_MINIMUM_SIZE = 0.00000001;
096
097    /** The default value for the lower margin (0.05 = 5%). */
098    public static final double DEFAULT_LOWER_MARGIN = 0.05;
099
100    /** The default value for the upper margin (0.05 = 5%). */
101    public static final double DEFAULT_UPPER_MARGIN = 0.05;
102
103    /** The default value for the range alignment. */
104    public static final RangeAlign DEFAULT_AUTO_RANGE_ALIGN = RangeAlign.UPPER;
105

108

111

113    public static final double MINIMUM_RANGE_MINIMUM_SIZE = Double.MIN_VALUE * 2;

219    /**
220     * Constructs a value axis.
221     *
222     * @param label             the axis label ({@code null} permitted).
223     * @param standardTickUnits the source for standard tick units ({@code null}
224     *                          permitted).
225     */
226    protected ValueAxis(String label, TickUnitSource standardTickUnits) {
227
228        super(label);
229
230        this.positiveArrowVisible = false;
231        this.negativeArrowVisible = false;
232
233        this.range = DEFAULT_RANGE;
234        this.autoRange = DEFAULT_AUTO_RANGE;
235        this.defaultAutoRange = DEFAULT_RANGE;
236        this.autoRangeAlign = DEFAULT_AUTO_RANGE_ALIGN;
237        this.rangeMinimumSize = MINIMUM_RANGE_MINIMUM_SIZE;
238        this.minimumRange = false;
239
240        this.inverted = DEFAULT_INVERTED;
241        this.autoRangeMinimumSize = DEFAULT_AUTO_RANGE_MINIMUM_SIZE;
242
243        this.lowerMargin = DEFAULT_LOWER_MARGIN;
244        this.upperMargin = DEFAULT_UPPER_MARGIN;
245
246        this.fixedAutoRange = 0.0;
247
248        this.autoTickUnitSelection = DEFAULT_AUTO_TICK_UNIT_SELECTION;
249        this.standardTickUnits = standardTickUnits;
250
251        Polygon p1 = new Polygon();
252        p1.addPoint(0, 0);
253        p1.addPoint(-2, 2);
254        p1.addPoint(2, 2);
255
256        this.upArrow = p1;
257
258        Polygon p2 = new Polygon();
259        p2.addPoint(0, 0);
260        p2.addPoint(-2, -2);
261        p2.addPoint(2, -2);
262
263        this.downArrow = p2;
264
265        Polygon p3 = new Polygon();
266        p3.addPoint(0, 0);
267        p3.addPoint(-2, -2);
268        p3.addPoint(-2, 2);
269
270        this.rightArrow = p3;
271
272        Polygon p4 = new Polygon();
273        p4.addPoint(0, 0);
274        p4.addPoint(2, -2);
275        p4.addPoint(2, 2);
276
277        this.leftArrow = p4;
278
279        this.verticalTickLabels = false;
280        this.minorTickCount = 0;
281
282    }

473    /**
474     * Draws an axis line at the current cursor position and edge.
475     *
476     * @param g2  the graphics device ({@code null} not permitted).
477     * @param cursor  the cursor position.
478     * @param dataArea  the data area.
479     * @param edge  the edge.
480     */
481    @Override
482    protected void drawAxisLine(Graphics2D g2, double cursor,
483            Rectangle2D dataArea, RectangleEdge edge) {
484        Line2D axisLine = null;
485        double c = cursor;
486        if (edge == RectangleEdge.TOP) {
487            axisLine = new Line2D.Double(dataArea.getX(), c, dataArea.getMaxX(),
488                    c);
489        } else if (edge == RectangleEdge.BOTTOM) {
490            axisLine = new Line2D.Double(dataArea.getX(), c, dataArea.getMaxX(),
491                    c);
492        } else if (edge == RectangleEdge.LEFT) {
493            axisLine = new Line2D.Double(c, dataArea.getY(), c, 
494                    dataArea.getMaxY());
495        } else if (edge == RectangleEdge.RIGHT) {
496            axisLine = new Line2D.Double(c, dataArea.getY(), c,
497                    dataArea.getMaxY());
498        }
499        g2.setPaint(getAxisLinePaint());
500        g2.setStroke(getAxisLineStroke());
501        Object saved = g2.getRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_STROKE_CONTROL);
502        g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_STROKE_CONTROL, 
503                RenderingHints.VALUE_STROKE_NORMALIZE);
504        g2.draw(axisLine);
505        g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_STROKE_CONTROL, saved);
506
507        boolean drawUpOrRight = false;
508        boolean drawDownOrLeft = false;
509        if (this.positiveArrowVisible) {
510            if (this.inverted) {
511                drawDownOrLeft = true;
512            }
513            else {
514                drawUpOrRight = true;
515            }
516        }
517        if (this.negativeArrowVisible) {
518            if (this.inverted) {
519                drawUpOrRight = true;
520            } else {
521                drawDownOrLeft = true;
522            }
523        }
524        if (drawUpOrRight) {
525            double x = 0.0;
526            double y = 0.0;
527            Shape arrow = null;
528            if (edge == RectangleEdge.TOP || edge == RectangleEdge.BOTTOM) {
529                x = dataArea.getMaxX();
530                y = cursor;
531                arrow = this.rightArrow;
532            } else if (edge == RectangleEdge.LEFT
533                    || edge == RectangleEdge.RIGHT) {
534                x = cursor;
535                y = dataArea.getMinY();
536                arrow = this.upArrow;
537            }
538
539            // draw the arrow...
540            AffineTransform transformer = new AffineTransform();
541            transformer.setToTranslation(x, y);
542            Shape shape = transformer.createTransformedShape(arrow);
543            g2.fill(shape);
544            g2.draw(shape);
545        }
546
547        if (drawDownOrLeft) {
548            double x = 0.0;
549            double y = 0.0;
550            Shape arrow = null;
551            if (edge == RectangleEdge.TOP || edge == RectangleEdge.BOTTOM) {
552                x = dataArea.getMinX();
553                y = cursor;
554                arrow = this.leftArrow;
555            } else if (edge == RectangleEdge.LEFT
556                    || edge == RectangleEdge.RIGHT) {
557                x = cursor;
558                y = dataArea.getMaxY();
559                arrow = this.downArrow;
560            }
561
562            // draw the arrow...
563            AffineTransform transformer = new AffineTransform();
564            transformer.setToTranslation(x, y);
565            Shape shape = transformer.createTransformedShape(arrow);
566            g2.fill(shape);
567            g2.draw(shape);
568        }
569
570    }
571
572    /**
573     * Calculates the anchor point for a tick label.
574     *
575     * @param tick  the tick.
576     * @param cursor  the cursor.
577     * @param dataArea  the data area.
578     * @param edge  the edge on which the axis is drawn.
579     *
580     * @return The x and y coordinates of the anchor point.
581     */
582    protected float[] calculateAnchorPoint(ValueTick tick, double cursor,
583            Rectangle2D dataArea, RectangleEdge edge) {
584
585        RectangleInsets insets = getTickLabelInsets();
586        float[] result = new float[2];
587        if (edge == RectangleEdge.TOP) {
588            result[0] = (float) valueToJava2D(tick.getValue(), dataArea, edge);
589            result[1] = (float) (cursor - insets.getBottom() - 2.0);
590        }
591        else if (edge == RectangleEdge.BOTTOM) {
592            result[0] = (float) valueToJava2D(tick.getValue(), dataArea, edge);
593            result[1] = (float) (cursor + insets.getTop() + 2.0);
594        }
595        else if (edge == RectangleEdge.LEFT) {
596            result[0] = (float) (cursor - insets.getLeft() - 2.0);
597            result[1] = (float) valueToJava2D(tick.getValue(), dataArea, edge);
598        }
599        else if (edge == RectangleEdge.RIGHT) {
600            result[0] = (float) (cursor + insets.getRight() + 2.0);
601            result[1] = (float) valueToJava2D(tick.getValue(), dataArea, edge);
602        }
603        return result;
604    }
605
606    /**
607     * Draws the axis line, tick marks and tick mark labels.
608     *
609     * @param g2  the graphics device ({@code null} not permitted).
610     * @param cursor  the cursor.
611     * @param plotArea  the plot area ({@code null} not permitted).
612     * @param dataArea  the data area ({@code null} not permitted).
613     * @param edge  the edge that the axis is aligned with ({@code null} 
614     *     not permitted).
615     *
616     * @return The width or height used to draw the axis.
617     */
618    protected AxisState drawTickMarksAndLabels(Graphics2D g2,
619            double cursor, Rectangle2D plotArea, Rectangle2D dataArea,
620            RectangleEdge edge) {
621
622        AxisState state = new AxisState(cursor);
623        if (isAxisLineVisible()) {
624            drawAxisLine(g2, cursor, dataArea, edge);
625        }
626        List ticks = refreshTicks(g2, state, dataArea, edge);
627        state.setTicks(ticks);
628        g2.setFont(getTickLabelFont());
629        Object saved = g2.getRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_STROKE_CONTROL);
630        g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_STROKE_CONTROL, 
631                RenderingHints.VALUE_STROKE_NORMALIZE);
632        Iterator iterator = ticks.iterator();
633        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
634            ValueTick tick = (ValueTick) iterator.next();
635            if (isTickLabelsVisible()) {
636                g2.setPaint(getTickLabelPaint());
637                float[] anchorPoint = calculateAnchorPoint(tick, cursor,
638                        dataArea, edge);
639                if (tick instanceof LogTick) {
640                    LogTick lt = (LogTick) tick;
641                    if (lt.getAttributedLabel() == null) {
642                        continue;
643                    }
644                    AttrStringUtils.drawRotatedString(lt.getAttributedLabel(), 
645                            g2, anchorPoint[0], anchorPoint[1], 
646                            tick.getTextAnchor(), tick.getAngle(), 
647                            tick.getRotationAnchor());
648                } else {
649                    if (tick.getText() == null) {
650                        continue;
651                    }
652                    TextUtils.drawRotatedString(tick.getText(), g2,
653                            anchorPoint[0], anchorPoint[1], 
654                            tick.getTextAnchor(), tick.getAngle(), 
655                            tick.getRotationAnchor());
656                }
657            }
658
659            if ((isTickMarksVisible() && tick.getTickType().equals(
660                    TickType.MAJOR)) || (isMinorTickMarksVisible()
661                    && tick.getTickType().equals(TickType.MINOR))) {
662
663                double ol = (tick.getTickType().equals(TickType.MINOR)) 
664                        ? getMinorTickMarkOutsideLength()
665                        : getTickMarkOutsideLength();
666
667                double il = (tick.getTickType().equals(TickType.MINOR)) 
668                        ? getMinorTickMarkInsideLength()
669                        : getTickMarkInsideLength();
670
671                float xx = (float) valueToJava2D(tick.getValue(), dataArea,
672                        edge);
673                Line2D mark = null;
674                g2.setStroke(getTickMarkStroke());
675                g2.setPaint(getTickMarkPaint());
676                if (edge == RectangleEdge.LEFT) {
677                    mark = new Line2D.Double(cursor - ol, xx, cursor + il, xx);
678                }
679                else if (edge == RectangleEdge.RIGHT) {
680                    mark = new Line2D.Double(cursor + ol, xx, cursor - il, xx);
681                }
682                else if (edge == RectangleEdge.TOP) {
683                    mark = new Line2D.Double(xx, cursor - ol, xx, cursor + il);
684                }
685                else if (edge == RectangleEdge.BOTTOM) {
686                    mark = new Line2D.Double(xx, cursor + ol, xx, cursor - il);
687                }
688                g2.draw(mark);
689            }
690        }
691        g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_STROKE_CONTROL, saved);
692        
693        // need to work out the space used by the tick labels...
694        // so we can update the cursor...
695        double used = 0.0;
696        if (isTickLabelsVisible()) {
697            if (edge == RectangleEdge.LEFT) {
698                used += findMaximumTickLabelWidth(ticks, g2, plotArea,
699                        isVerticalTickLabels());
700                state.cursorLeft(used);
701            } else if (edge == RectangleEdge.RIGHT) {
702                used = findMaximumTickLabelWidth(ticks, g2, plotArea,
703                        isVerticalTickLabels());
704                state.cursorRight(used);
705            } else if (edge == RectangleEdge.TOP) {
706                used = findMaximumTickLabelHeight(ticks, g2, plotArea,
707                        isVerticalTickLabels());
708                state.cursorUp(used);
709            } else if (edge == RectangleEdge.BOTTOM) {
710                used = findMaximumTickLabelHeight(ticks, g2, plotArea,
711                        isVerticalTickLabels());
712                state.cursorDown(used);
713            }
714        }
715
716        return state;
717    }

719    /**
720     * Returns the space required to draw the axis.
721     *
722     * @param g2  the graphics device.
723     * @param plot  the plot that the axis belongs to.
724     * @param plotArea  the area within which the plot should be drawn.
725     * @param edge  the axis location.
726     * @param space  the space already reserved (for other axes).
727     *
728     * @return The space required to draw the axis (including pre-reserved
729     *         space).
730     */
731    @Override
732    public AxisSpace reserveSpace(Graphics2D g2, Plot plot, 
733            Rectangle2D plotArea, RectangleEdge edge, AxisSpace space) {
734
735        // create a new space object if one wasn't supplied...
736        if (space == null) {
737            space = new AxisSpace();
738        }
739
740        // if the axis is not visible, no additional space is required...
741        if (!isVisible()) {
742            return space;
743        }
744
745        // if the axis has a fixed dimension, return it...
746        double dimension = getFixedDimension();
747        if (dimension > 0.0) {
748            space.add(dimension, edge);
749            return space;
750        }
751
752        // calculate the max size of the tick labels (if visible)...
753        double tickLabelHeight = 0.0;
754        double tickLabelWidth = 0.0;
755        if (isTickLabelsVisible()) {
756            g2.setFont(getTickLabelFont());
757            List ticks = refreshTicks(g2, new AxisState(), plotArea, edge);
758            if (RectangleEdge.isTopOrBottom(edge)) {
759                tickLabelHeight = findMaximumTickLabelHeight(ticks, g2,
760                        plotArea, isVerticalTickLabels());
761            }
762            else if (RectangleEdge.isLeftOrRight(edge)) {
763                tickLabelWidth = findMaximumTickLabelWidth(ticks, g2, plotArea,
764                        isVerticalTickLabels());
765            }
766        }
767
768        // get the axis label size and update the space object...
769        Rectangle2D labelEnclosure = getLabelEnclosure(g2, edge);
770        if (RectangleEdge.isTopOrBottom(edge)) {
771            double labelHeight = labelEnclosure.getHeight();
772            space.add(labelHeight + tickLabelHeight, edge);
773        }
774        else if (RectangleEdge.isLeftOrRight(edge)) {
775            double labelWidth = labelEnclosure.getWidth();
776            space.add(labelWidth + tickLabelWidth, edge);
777        }
778
779        return space;
780
781    }
782
783    /**
784     * A utility method for determining the height of the tallest tick label.
785     *
786     * @param ticks  the ticks.
787     * @param g2  the graphics device.
788     * @param drawArea  the area within which the plot and axes should be drawn.
789     * @param vertical  a flag that indicates whether the tick labels
790     *                  are 'vertical'.
791     *
792     * @return The height of the tallest tick label.
793     */
794    protected double findMaximumTickLabelHeight(List ticks, Graphics2D g2,
795            Rectangle2D drawArea, boolean vertical) {
796
797        RectangleInsets insets = getTickLabelInsets();
798        Font font = getTickLabelFont();
799        g2.setFont(font);
800        double maxHeight = 0.0;
801        if (vertical) {
802            FontMetrics fm = g2.getFontMetrics(font);
803            Iterator iterator = ticks.iterator();
804            while (iterator.hasNext()) {
805                Tick tick = (Tick) iterator.next();
806                Rectangle2D labelBounds = null;
807                if (tick instanceof LogTick) {
808                    LogTick lt = (LogTick) tick;
809                    if (lt.getAttributedLabel() != null) {
810                        labelBounds = AttrStringUtils.getTextBounds(
811                                lt.getAttributedLabel(), g2);
812                    }
813                } else if (tick.getText() != null) {
814                    labelBounds = TextUtils.getTextBounds(
815                            tick.getText(), g2, fm);
816                }
817                if (labelBounds != null && labelBounds.getWidth() 
818                        + insets.getTop() + insets.getBottom() > maxHeight) {
819                    maxHeight = labelBounds.getWidth()
820                                + insets.getTop() + insets.getBottom();
821                }
822            }
823        } else {
824            LineMetrics metrics = font.getLineMetrics("ABCxyz",
825                    g2.getFontRenderContext());
826            maxHeight = metrics.getHeight()
827                        + insets.getTop() + insets.getBottom();
828        }
829        return maxHeight;
830
831    }
832
833    /**
834     * A utility method for determining the width of the widest tick label.
835     *
836     * @param ticks  the ticks.
837     * @param g2  the graphics device.
838     * @param drawArea  the area within which the plot and axes should be drawn.
839     * @param vertical  a flag that indicates whether the tick labels
840     *                  are 'vertical'.
841     *
842     * @return The width of the tallest tick label.
843     */
844    protected double findMaximumTickLabelWidth(List ticks, Graphics2D g2,
845            Rectangle2D drawArea, boolean vertical) {
846
847        RectangleInsets insets = getTickLabelInsets();
848        Font font = getTickLabelFont();
849        double maxWidth = 0.0;
850        if (!vertical) {
851            FontMetrics fm = g2.getFontMetrics(font);
852            Iterator iterator = ticks.iterator();
853            while (iterator.hasNext()) {
854                Tick tick = (Tick) iterator.next();
855                Rectangle2D labelBounds = null;
856                if (tick instanceof LogTick) {
857                    LogTick lt = (LogTick) tick;
858                    if (lt.getAttributedLabel() != null) {
859                        labelBounds = AttrStringUtils.getTextBounds(
860                                lt.getAttributedLabel(), g2);
861                    }
862                } else if (tick.getText() != null) {
863                    labelBounds = TextUtils.getTextBounds(tick.getText(), 
864                            g2, fm);
865                }
866                if (labelBounds != null 
867                        && labelBounds.getWidth() + insets.getLeft()
868                        + insets.getRight() > maxWidth) {
869                    maxWidth = labelBounds.getWidth()
870                               + insets.getLeft() + insets.getRight();
871                }
872            }
873        } else {
874            LineMetrics metrics = font.getLineMetrics("ABCxyz",
875                    g2.getFontRenderContext());
876            maxWidth = metrics.getHeight()
877                       + insets.getTop() + insets.getBottom();
878        }
879        return maxWidth;
880
881    }

1239     * listeners.  As a side-effect, the auto-range flag is set to
1240     * {@code false}.
1241     *
1242     * @param range  the range ({@code null} not permitted).
1243     *

1251    /**
1252     * Sets the range for the axis and, if requested, sends a change event to 
1253     * all registered listeners.  Furthermore, if {@code turnOffAutoRange}
1254     * is {@code true}, the auto-range flag is set to {@code false} 
1255     * (normally when setting the axis range manually the caller expects that
1256     * range to remain in force).
1257     *
1258     * @param range  the range ({@code null} not permitted).
1259     * @param turnOffAutoRange  a flag that controls whether the auto
1260     *                          range is turned off.
1261     * @param notify  a flag that controls whether listeners are
1262     *                notified.
1263     *
1264     * @see #getRange()
1265     */
1266    public void setRange(Range range, boolean turnOffAutoRange, 
1267            boolean notify) {
1268        Args.nullNotPermitted(range, "range");
1269        if (range.getLength() <= 0.0) {
1270            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
1271                    "A positive range length is required: " + range);
1272        }
1273        if (turnOffAutoRange) {
1274            this.autoRange = false;
1275        }
1276        final double rangeNewSize = range.getLength();
1277        if (rangeNewSize < this.rangeMinimumSize) {
1278            if (!this.minimumRange || !this.range.contains(range)) {
1279                // Only if we're not zoomed into maximum yet, we'll zoom in as
1280                // much as possible
1281                final double centralValue = range.getCentralValue();
1282                final double halfLength = this.rangeMinimumSize / 2;
1283                this.range = new Range(centralValue - halfLength,
1284                        centralValue + halfLength);
1285                this.minimumRange = true;
1286            } else {
1287                return;
1288            }
1289        } else {
1290            this.minimumRange = rangeNewSize == this.rangeMinimumSize;
1291            this.range = range;
1292        }
1293        if (notify) {
1294            fireChangeEvent();
1295        }
1296    }

1367    /**
1368     * Sets the minimum range size for this axis.
1369     * 
1370     * @param rangeMinimumSize the minimum range size for this axis.
1371     */
1372    public void setRangeMinimumSize(double rangeMinimumSize) {
1373        if (Double.isNaN(rangeMinimumSize)
1374                || rangeMinimumSize < MINIMUM_RANGE_MINIMUM_SIZE) {
1375            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
1376                    "A positive range minimum size is required: "
1377                            + rangeMinimumSize);
1378        }
1379        this.rangeMinimumSize = rangeMinimumSize;
1380        final double rangeCurrentSize = this.range.getLength();
1381        if (rangeCurrentSize < rangeMinimumSize) {
1382            setRange(this.range);
1383        } else if (rangeCurrentSize > rangeMinimumSize) {
1384            this.minimumRange = false;
1385        } else {
1386            this.minimumRange = true;
1387        }
1388    }

1496    /**
1497     * Converts a data value to a coordinate in Java2D space, assuming that the
1498     * axis runs along one edge of the specified dataArea.
1499     * <p>
1500     * Note that it is possible for the coordinate to fall outside the area.
1501     *
1502     * @param value  the data value.
1503     * @param area  the area for plotting the data.
1504     * @param edge  the edge along which the axis lies.
1505     *
1506     * @return The Java2D coordinate.
1507     *
1508     * @see #java2DToValue(double, Rectangle2D, RectangleEdge)
1509     */
1510    public abstract double valueToJava2D(double value, Rectangle2D area,
1511                                         RectangleEdge edge);
1512
1513    /**
1514     * Converts a length in data coordinates into the corresponding length in
1515     * Java2D coordinates.
1516     *
1517     * @param length  the length.
1518     * @param area  the plot area.
1519     * @param edge  the edge along which the axis lies.
1520     *
1521     * @return The length in Java2D coordinates.
1522     */
1523    public double lengthToJava2D(double length, Rectangle2D area,
1524                                 RectangleEdge edge) {
1525        double zero = valueToJava2D(0.0, area, edge);
1526        double l = valueToJava2D(length, area, edge);
1527        return Math.abs(l - zero);
1528    }

1542    public abstract double java2DToValue(double java2DValue, Rectangle2D area,

1545    /**
1546     * Automatically sets the axis range to fit the range of values in the
1547     * dataset.  Sometimes this can depend on the renderer used as well (for
1548     * example, the renderer may "stack" values, requiring an axis range
1549     * greater than otherwise necessary).
1550     */
1551    protected final void autoAdjustRange() {
1552        Range range = calculateAutoRange(true);
1553        if (null != range) {
1554            setRange(range, false, false);
1555        }
1556    }
1557
1558    /**
1559     * Calculates the axis range to fit the range of values in the dataset.
1560     * 
1561     * @return the calculated axis range to fit the range of values in the
1562     *         dataset. {@code null} if range could not be calculated.
1563     * @param adhereToMax specifies whether range should adhere to its maximum
1564     *                    boundaries (e.g. {@link #getFixedAutoRange()})
1565     * @see #autoAdjustRange()
1566     */
1567    public abstract Range calculateAutoRange(boolean adhereToMax);
1568
1569    /**
1570     * Centers the axis range about the specified value and sends an
1571     * {@link AxisChangeEvent} to all registered listeners.
1572     *
1573     * @param value  the center value.
1574     */
1575    public void centerRange(double value) {
1576        double central = this.range.getCentralValue();
1577        Range adjusted = new Range(this.range.getLowerBound() + value - central,
1578                this.range.getUpperBound() + value - central);
1579        setRange(adjusted);
1580    }
1581
1582    /**
1583     * Increases or decreases the axis range by the specified percentage about
1584     * the central value and sends an {@link AxisChangeEvent} to all registered
1585     * listeners.
1586     * <P>
1587     * To double the length of the axis range, use 200% (2.0).
1588     * To halve the length of the axis range, use 50% (0.5).
1589     *
1590     * @param percent  the resize factor.
1591     *
1592     * @see #resizeRange(double, double)
1593     */
1594    public void resizeRange(double percent) {
1595        resizeRange(percent, this.range.getCentralValue());
1596    }
1597
1598    /**
1599     * Increases or decreases the axis range by the specified percentage about
1600     * the specified anchor value and sends an {@link AxisChangeEvent} to all
1601     * registered listeners.
1602     * <P>
1603     * To double the length of the axis range, use 200% (2.0).
1604     * To halve the length of the axis range, use 50% (0.5).
1605     *
1606     * @param percent  the resize factor.
1607     * @param anchorValue  the new central value after the resize.
1608     *
1609     * @see #resizeRange(double)
1610     */
1611    public void resizeRange(double percent, double anchorValue) {
1612        if (percent > 0.0) {
1613            double halfLength = this.range.getLength() * percent / 2;
1614            Range adjusted = new Range(anchorValue - halfLength,
1615                    anchorValue + halfLength);
1616            setRange(adjusted);
1617        }
1618        else {
1619            setAutoRange(true);
1620        }
1621    }
1622
1623    /**
1624     * Increases or decreases the axis range by the specified percentage about
1625     * the specified anchor value and sends an {@link AxisChangeEvent} to all
1626     * registered listeners.
1627     * <P>
1628     * To double the length of the axis range, use 200% (2.0).
1629     * To halve the length of the axis range, use 50% (0.5).
1630     *
1631     * @param percent  the resize factor.
1632     * @param anchorValue  the new central value after the resize.
1633     *
1634     * @see #resizeRange(double)
1635     */
1636    public void resizeRange2(double percent, double anchorValue) {
1637        if (percent > 0.0) {
1638            double left = anchorValue - getLowerBound();
1639            double right = getUpperBound() - anchorValue;
1640            Range adjusted = new Range(anchorValue - left * percent,
1641                    anchorValue + right * percent);
1642            setRange(adjusted);
1643        }
1644        else {
1645            setAutoRange(true);
1646        }
1647    }
1648
1649    /**
1650     * Zooms in on the current range.
1651     *
1652     * @param lowerPercent  the new lower bound.
1653     * @param upperPercent  the new upper bound.
1654     */
1655    public void zoomRange(double lowerPercent, double upperPercent) {
1656        double start = this.range.getLowerBound();
1657        double length = this.range.getLength();
1658        double r0, r1;
1659        if (isInverted()) {
1660            r0 = start + (length * (1 - upperPercent));
1661            r1 = start + (length * (1 - lowerPercent));
1662        }
1663        else {
1664            r0 = start + length * lowerPercent;
1665            r1 = start + length * upperPercent;
1666        }
1667        if ((r1 > r0) && !Double.isInfinite(r1 - r0)) {
1668            setRange(new Range(r0, r1));
1669        }
1670    }
1671
1672    /**
1673     * Slides the axis range by the specified percentage.
1674     *
1675     * @param percent  the percentage.
1676     */
1677    public void pan(double percent) {
1678        Range r = getRange();
1679        double length = range.getLength();
1680        double adj = length * percent;
1681        double lower = r.getLowerBound() + adj;
1682        double upper = r.getUpperBound() + adj;
1683        setRange(lower, upper);
1684    }

1708    /**
1709     * Tests the axis for equality with an arbitrary object.
1710     *
1711     * @param obj  the object ({@code null} permitted).
1712     *
1713     * @return {@code true} or {@code false}.
1714     */
1715    @Override
1716    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
1717        if (obj == this) {
1718            return true;
1719        }
1720        if (!(obj instanceof ValueAxis)) {
1721            return false;
1722        }
1723        ValueAxis that = (ValueAxis) obj;
1724        if (this.positiveArrowVisible != that.positiveArrowVisible) {
1725            return false;
1726        }
1727        if (this.negativeArrowVisible != that.negativeArrowVisible) {
1728            return false;
1729        }
1730        if (this.inverted != that.inverted) {
1731            return false;
1732        }
1733        // if autoRange is true, then the current range is irrelevant
1734        if (!this.autoRange && !Objects.equals(this.range, that.range)) {
1735            return false;
1736        }
1737        if (this.autoRange != that.autoRange) {
1738            return false;
1739        }
1740        if (this.autoRangeMinimumSize != that.autoRangeMinimumSize) {
1741            return false;
1742        }
1743        if (!this.defaultAutoRange.equals(that.defaultAutoRange)) {
1744            return false;
1745        }
1746        if (this.upperMargin != that.upperMargin) {
1747            return false;
1748        }
1749        if (this.lowerMargin != that.lowerMargin) {
1750            return false;
1751        }
1752        if (this.fixedAutoRange != that.fixedAutoRange) {
1753            return false;
1754        }
1755        if (this.autoTickUnitSelection != that.autoTickUnitSelection) {
1756            return false;
1757        }
1758        if (!Objects.equals(this.standardTickUnits, that.standardTickUnits)) {
1759            return false;
1760        }
1761        if (this.verticalTickLabels != that.verticalTickLabels) {
1762            return false;
1763        }
1764        if (this.minorTickCount != that.minorTickCount) {
1765            return false;
1766        }
1767        if (this.rangeMinimumSize != that.rangeMinimumSize) {
1768            return false;
1769        }
1770        return super.equals(obj);
1771    }

1787    /**
1788     * Provides serialization support.
1789     *
1790     * @param stream  the output stream.
1791     *
1792     * @throws IOException  if there is an I/O error.
1793     */
1794    private void writeObject(ObjectOutputStream stream) throws IOException {
1795        stream.defaultWriteObject();
1796        SerialUtils.writeShape(this.upArrow, stream);
1797        SerialUtils.writeShape(this.downArrow, stream);
1798        SerialUtils.writeShape(this.leftArrow, stream);
1799        SerialUtils.writeShape(this.rightArrow, stream);
1800    }
1801
1802    /**
1803     * Provides serialization support.
1804     *
1805     * @param stream  the input stream.
1806     *
1807     * @throws IOException  if there is an I/O error.
1808     * @throws ClassNotFoundException  if there is a classpath problem.
1809     */
1810    private void readObject(ObjectInputStream stream)
1811            throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException {
1812
1813        stream.defaultReadObject();
1814        this.upArrow = SerialUtils.readShape(stream);
1815        this.downArrow = SerialUtils.readShape(stream);
1816        this.leftArrow = SerialUtils.readShape(stream);
1817        this.rightArrow = SerialUtils.readShape(stream);
1818    }
